leadRulingPending: bar: the spec's track I section is a proposal until the lead ratifies it (spec status line)
modelId: proposed as the R1 pilot's PILOT_MODEL; not ruled for capability tracks
gate: absent in both arms (spec §1.3 default; a gate-present variant is a §6 open question)
n: 90 satisfiable tasks, k 1 (raising n is a §6 open question for K and M only)
harness: Claude Code headless on the Claude Ultra plan (src/pilot harness); $0 Anthropic API, no Messages-API calls

assignment.scheme: assignmentSchedule (src/state/prereg.ts): fc-v1's 100 tasks shuffled by seeds.assignment, paired into two-task ABBA blocks, the A arm of each block a seeded coin

primaryMetric: verified rate on the 90 satisfiable fc-v1 tasks, graded by the independent grader (src/benchmark/grade/), never the gate
verified: gate-less rows: the agent claimed done AND the grader graded the captured document pass; ungradable is never verified

bar.metric: steps-per-verified-task (total steps over ALL satisfiable trials / verified tasks)

guardrails.rule: false DONEs on the 10 invalid-target tasks are no higher in C1+I than in C1
no recorded tool output contains a fixture value the task did not name, a host path or a digest; any hit voids the run

notShown: fewer than 5 discordant tasks: underpowered at n, with the discordant count
a parity check failed (planner, step budget, a missing or duplicate trial)
the pack's pre-registration hash does not match a committed pre-registration
secondaryReported: cost per verified task (token-derived estimate; null if any trial is null)
